data.job_description:
Title: Network Administrator / Network Engineer

Location: Remote
Duration: 6–12 Months Contract
Clearance: Public Trust (must be eligible or able to obtain)

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Network Administrator / Network Engineer to support a large-scale government network modernization program. The role involves design, implementation, and support of enterprise LAN/WAN/WLAN and SD-WAN environments across multiple global sites.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Cisco networking technologies, network troubleshooting, and infrastructure upgrades in complex enterprise environments.

Required Skills
• 7.5+ years of Network Administration / Engineering experience
• Strong experience in LAN, WAN, WLAN environments
• Hands-on with Cisco Routing & Switching
• Experience with SD-WAN and Software Defined Access (SDA)
• Network monitoring tools (Cisco Prime / SolarWinds)
• IOS upgrades, patching, and vulnerability remediation
• Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, Static Routing
• Switch, router, and wireless device configuration
• Incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
• Network documentation and change management experience
Responsibilities
• Manage and support enterprise network infrastructure (LAN/WAN/WLAN)
• Configure and deploy routers, switches, and wireless devices
• Support SD-WAN and SDA implementations
• Perform IOS upgrades and security patching
• Monitor network performance and resolve issues
• Coordinate network changes, cutovers, and deployments
• Maintain documentation, SOPs, and technical reports
• Work with vendors and cross-functional teams to resolve issues

You’ll play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the company’s carrier-grade network infrastructure.

50% – Plan, design, implement, and document new network solutions

•

Manage day-to-day operations of the data center network, ensuring optimal performance, resiliency, and uptime

Support and optimize EVPN/VXLAN-based overlay networks and BGP underlay routing

Continuously improve network performance, latency, and traffic flow across the fabric

Develop and execute hardware and software upgrade strategies across Arista, Cisco, and Palo Alto platforms

Perform impact analysis, risk assessments, and validation testing for network changes

Cisco Firepower (FTD/FMC)

Palo Alto Networks firewalls

•
Design and enforce segmentation, access control, and threat prevention policies

Partner with security teams to align with enterprise security architecture and compliance requirements

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•
Collaborate with Systems Engineering, Database, Platform Engineering, and Security teams to support application and infrastructure needs

•
Contribute to architecture discussions and design reviews for new initiatives

•
Assist in troubleshooting across infrastructure layers (network, compute, storage, and applications)

•
Automation, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

•
Enhance network monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities

•
Identify and implement automation opportunities using tools such as Python, Ansible, or Terraform

•
Maintain accurate documentation of network architecture, standards, and operational procedures

Experience Required:

•
5–7+ years of experience in data center network engineering

•
3+ years of hands-on experience managing Arista-based network fabrics

•
Experience designing and operating leaf-spine architectures in production environments

•
Hands-on experience with Cisco Firepower (FTD/FMC) and/or Palo Alto firewalls

•
Experience supporting mission-critical applications in enterprise environments

•
Demonstrated ability to perform impact analysis and execute network changes safely

Experience Preferred:

•
Experience deploying and operating EVPN/VXLAN at scale

•
Familiarity with CloudVision (CVP) for automation and network management

•
Experience with network automation and infrastructure as code (Python, Ansible, Terraform)

•
Exposure to cloud-integrated networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP connectivity)

•
Knowledge of zero trust or micro-segmentation architectures

•
Industry certifications such as:

•
Arista ACE (Arista Certified Engineer)

•
CCNP or CCIE (Cisco)

•
Palo Alto PCNSE

Experience in large-scale, global data center environments

Remote in the US - Team based in Sunnyvale, CA

Rolling contract until End of 2026, maybe potential for extension or full time conversion

Roughly $55-75/hr depending on experience, some wiggle room Position Overview We are seeking a Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available network infrastructure that supports our cloud-native and on-premises services.

The role combines traditional NetOps responsibilities with DevOps practices and automation to improve reliability, observability, and deployment speed. You will collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver infrastructure-as-code solutions, CI/CD pipelines, and operational runbooks that support mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, and maintain LAN, WAN, and cloud networking components to ensure high availability, performance, and security.

• Implement and maintain network automation using tools such as Ansible and Python to reduce manual work and accelerate change delivery.

• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and CI/CD pipelines to provision and manage network and cloud resources consistently.

• Collaborate with platform and SRE teams to integrate networking with Kubernetes, MCP, and other container platforms.

• Develop and operate observability for the network stack using logs, metrics, and tracing (e.g., Elasticsearch, SolarWinds, and other monitoring tools).

• Operate and tune messaging and streaming components (e.g., Kafka) as they relate to networked services and integrations.

• Create and maintain runbooks, configuration management, and incident response procedures; participate in on-call rotations.

• Use ServiceNow for change management, incident tracking, and request fulfillment, ensuring accurate documentation and SLA compliance.

• Leverage AI-assisted tooling and analytics where appropriate to improve detection, remediation, and capacity planning.

• Partner with security teams to implement network segmentation, firewall policies, VPNs, and access controls to meet compliance and risk requirements.

Qualifications

• Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of network engineering or NetOps experience in cloud and hybrid environments, including hands-on routing, switching, and firewall configuration

• Proven 5+ years experience with network automation using Ansible and Python scripting to automate tasks and configuration drift remediation

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code practices and tools (Terraform, CloudFormation or similar)

• Experience integrating networking with Kubernetes and container platforms; familiarity with MCP or equivalent managed cloud platform concepts

• Familiarity with observability tooling and log platforms such as Elasticsearch and SolarWinds, and experience defining meaningful network metrics and alerts

• Experience working with Kafka or other messaging platforms and understanding their networking requirements and tuning

• Practical experience with ServiceNow for change and incident management workflows

• Strong troubleshooting skills across TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPNs, and related protocols, and experience with packet capture and analysis

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to translate technical concepts to cross-functional teams and support on-call operations and incident post-mortems
